message.body: Up to 5 different inputs can be executed at the same time by using + to combine inputs. message.body: Example: Up+Right+Square;120 X+O+Down;60 *5 Will pull Up and Right on the Left Analog Stick and press the Square Button for 120 frames (2 seconds), then press the X and O Buttons and pull Down on the Left Analog Stick for 60 frames (1 second), and *5 means the input will be executed once, then it will be repeated 5 times. There is no delay between inputs.
